question: Four letter-clusters have been given out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- Difference between the first two and the last two letter's position value according to English alphabetic series is equal.

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : SQO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f500a53c2146868a66260da3eccae69fa70d2671296428245f7f18e14e51cb70.png] 

 
• Option - (2) : YWU

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/df3eba109d2040221c4b0939373a074b193244db4d754e0436669e191f6bf915.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : MKI

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/271d3b6d623e68a6b9f980595a215cf6813a527187569d8843b68313f0c1e548.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : GED

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/86678d48be8e55ee1a044b641a80c318550ecbb1b3a77f23886a0cb3fb62890d.png] ​

Here, Only 'GED' difference between first two and last two letter's position value according to English alphabetic series is not equal.

Hence, the correct answer is "**GED**".
